lines.zh: 我低着头走，靠脚底摸索。
lines.en: I walk head down, feeling with my feet.

lines.zh: 我看不见，只能一步一步试。
lines.en: I cannot see. I test each step.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块石头，是碰到的。
lines.en: I go around a stone because I hit it.
I keep to the ground and do not look up.
My eyes are narrowed. The light is too strong.
I walk toward the dark.
I tap the ground, then tap again.

lines.zh: 我的脚掌踩在土上，很软。
lines.en: My feet press the soft soil.
I squeeze between grass roots.

lines.zh: 我绕过一束光，那让我难受。
lines.en: I go around a beam of light. It hurts.
I work along the wall's base.
I probe each step. Very slow.

lines.zh: 我把头伸进洞里，又缩回。
lines.en: I push my head into a hole and pull it back.

lines.zh: 我找到一个角落，挪过去。
lines.en: I find a corner and shuffle to it.

lines.zh: 我贴着另一只走，跟着脚步。
lines.en: I follow another, matching its steps.

lines.zh: 我用嘴碰了碰前面的东西。
lines.en: I touch what is ahead with my bill.
I crouch, eyes nearly shut.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，听土里的声音。
lines.en: I hold still and listen into the soil.
I tuck my head into my wings.
My feet scratch lightly at the ground.

lines.zh: 我在避开从缝里漏下的光。
lines.en: I am avoiding the light leaking through the gap.

lines.zh: 我偏过头，听墙那边的动静。
lines.en: I tilt my head toward the sound behind the wall.
The burrow is dark, and I see nothing.

lines.zh: 土从我的羽毛里落下来。
lines.en: Dirt falls out of my feathers.
I flatten against the ground.
I am waiting for the light to move.
I bury my bill in the soil.
When I am nervous, I do not move.
My eyes are very sensitive to light.
I am rooting through the soil.
I do not look at you. I cannot see you.
I turn my bill aside to find your footsteps.

lines.zh: 你身上的光让我退了一步。
lines.en: The light on you makes me step back.
I slowly turn toward you.

lines.zh: 你的脚步很重，我记住了。
lines.en: Your steps are heavy. I have noted them.
I retreat a little more.
I flatten myself down and freeze.

lines.zh: 你挡在光前面，我好受些。
lines.en: You block the light. That is better.
I feel my way around your feet.
I make no sound. I do not want to be found.
I shriek and jump.
I hit the wall and roll.
I curl up and barely dare to breathe.
Two feathers come loose.
I run and crash into things.
In my panic my bill knocks against the earth.
I dive into the nearest hole.
I shudder, and my feathers all splay out.
I press flat.
I get up slowly, still shaking.

lines.zh: 有东西的味道，我凑近了。
lines.en: Something smells. I come close.
I touch it with my bill.
I scratch it into the soil.
I peck twice and stop.
Not enough for a meal.
I circle your hand.
I lift my head to listen.
I tuck it under a wing.
I come near you, then draw back.
Your shadow is cool. I will stay here.
You bump me; I bolt.
I hit the wall headfirst.
I brace against the wall and hold my breath.

lines.zh: 你的脚碰到了我。我往旁边挪。
lines.en: Your foot touched me. I shuffle aside.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我摔了一跤。
lines.en: We collide; I take a tumble.
I flatten out like a lump of mud.
I right myself and shake off the dirt.

lines.zh: 我又撞了一下，这次轻些。
lines.en: I bump again. Lighter this time.
I squeeze out between your legs.
I squeeze into the nearest crack.
Another is in the dark too.
We stay close, by sound.
I touch its wing.
It touches me back.
We walk toward the dark together.

lines.zh: 它的呼吸和我的一样轻。
lines.en: Its breathing is as faint as mine.
We groom each other with our bills.

lines.zh: 它走在我前面，我跟得很紧。
lines.en: It goes first; I follow close.
I press against my mate for warmth.
Neither of us makes a sound.
I scratch it to my feet.
I tap it to hear whether it rings.
I bury my bill in it and hide it away.
Too hard. I cannot peck through.
I push it into the burrow.
I carry it in my bill into the burrow.
I drop it once and find it again.
I did not see it. I bumped into it.
I scrape soil over it with my bill.
I drop it and leave.
I hear you coming.
I retreat toward the dark at once.
I press low and hold still.
I mark the direction of your steps.
I hear you, and my heart races.
I start moving toward the corner.
I do not want to meet you.
I find a patch of loose soil on the wall.
I take off running for the dark.

lines.zh: 我跑的时候撞到了东西。
lines.en: I hit something as I run.
I have found a gap I can get through.
I back away with my wings pressed down.
I grope forward along the base of the wall.
The closer you come, the faster I go.
I crash and scramble up.
I run where there is no light.
My direction is a mess.
I turn away from your steps.
I push in among the grass roots.
I am hunting for a hole to get into.
I press to the ground and breathe shallowly.
I do not stop until I cannot run.
I push my head into the soil.
I hit the wall again.
I hear your footsteps behind me.
I peck in panic.
I beat at you with my wings.
I jab your ankle with my bill.
I crash into things as I run.
That one misses entirely.
I flail and crash about.
My bill hits a stone.
I back up into the wall.
I bolt past your feet.
I flap and run off.
I kick out wildly.
I peck my own wing by mistake.
I stir in the soil.
I raise my head. Too much light.
I dive for the dark at once.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边撞到东西。
lines.en: I bump into things as I walk.
I can barely open my eyes.
I find a shadow.
I shuffle half a turn at the burrow mouth.
I hear something far off.
I push my head up out of the soil.
I begin feeling my way.
I duck into the nearest hole.
I lie flat against the ground.
I hear it again.
It is too bright, so I shrink into the soil.

lines.zh: 火光照过来，我疼得往土里钻。
lines.en: The fire's light reaches me; I burrow away in pain.
I fall and hit hard.

lines.zh: 我不会游，水一盖上来我就乱扑。
lines.en: I cannot swim. Water closes over me and I flail.

lines.zh: 爆炸声吓得我撞在墙上。
lines.en: The blast frightens me into the wall.
An arrow buries in my feathers.
That light stabs my eyes.
I am too starved even to dig.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我撞翻了自己。
lines.en: The lightning flash makes me tumble over myself.

lines.zh: 下面是黑的，我掉了下去。
lines.en: It is black below. I fall.
